name: Desire Haze
description: The terrace stage hosts this indie rock and dream pop band for a free show under the stars.
longDescription:
Desire Haze, an indie rock and dream pop band, performs on the Casa da Música Terrace. The group is known for their atmospheric soundscapes and melodic compositions, drawing influences from both classic and contemporary alternative music. This performance offers an opportunity to hear their distinct blend of genres in an open-air setting.

Attendees can expect an evening of music under the night sky, with the performance lasting approximately 60-90 minutes. The Casa da Música Terrace provides an expansive outdoor space, suitable for a relaxed audience interested in contemporary music. The atmosphere is generally casual and welcoming to a diverse crowd.

This is a free event, and no tickets are required; entry is on a first-come, first-served basis. Casa da Música is located near the Casa da Música metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F). Several bus lines also serve the area. The venue is accessible for individuals with mobility impairments.
